about: Manual classification of the SP3 2005-2023 permanent-stop cases (in_window_events.boundary with E = 2023-12-29; pre_freeze.permanent_stops) that india/sp3.py prep stops cannot settle mechanically. The code settles two kinds itself: the 2011 sid-key switch (a symbol sid whose symbol carries an ISIN from the next sessions: renamed to that ISIN's entity) and the renames in NSE's symbol-change list (symbol_changes below, confirmed by the new symbol's first cash session following L). Every other case is listed here with its class, evidence (a record in silver/announce or silver/pr/announcements dated to 2023-12-29, or an exchange or index notice on the web) and, for renamed, the successor sid. prep stops refuses to run if this list and the computed case list differ. Classes: scheme (a scheme of arrangement, amalgamation, demerger or reconstruction ended the listing), voluntary_delisting (a delisting offer), renamed (the same company's shares kept trading under another symbol or ISIN; a relisting after a capital reduction is flagged), compulsory (delisted by the exchange, or under an IBC resolution plan that paid the shareholders nothing), liquidation (a winding-up or liquidation order), suspended_unresolved (suspended and neither resumed nor delisted by 2023-12-29), unresolved (no record settles it).
built: 2026-10-20, from records cut at 2023-12-29 and web lookups (NSE index press releases on niftyindices.com, NSE press releases and circulars on nsearchives.nseindia.com, the Calcutta Stock Exchange notice archive, one news report); no login, no members-only page
